desc:
Having a sling on your rifle is crucial, but not all slings are made equal. The Rebels Raiders Sling offers comfort and versatility with a quick-adjust feature that’s easily configured based on your shooting style. You can set it to tighten either forward (classic) or backward (reverse), using our tough 500D pull-tab for smooth, controlled adjustments. Plus, the padded area prevents that painful digging into your neck, whether you're transitioning from rifle to pistol or simply stowing your rifle to the side.

Every sling also includes two shock cord Sling Keepers and two universal mounting...tabs? I don't know what to call them, in any case we're giving you the option to wrap it around your rail or stock, keeping it tidy and out of the way when packed in a bag, case, or vehicle. When it’s go-time, just pull it out and sling up quick, reliable, and ready for action.

eatures & Specs

• 500D Nylon Construction
• Open End’s for unlimited mounting Options
• Includes Two Sling Keepers & Tabs
• Maximum Useable Length: ~ 66.5 in.
• Minimum Useable Length: ~ 35.5 in.
• Padding Dimensions (LxW): 21 in. x 1.5 in.
• Padding Thickness: 0.6 in.
• Weight (without attachments): 3.7 oz Honestly who's weighing a sling?
• Made In Vietnam so it will love you long time
